summary: Celcuity Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the submission of a supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) to the FDA for REVTORPYK (gedatolisib) to treat HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer with PIK3CA mutations. This is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing includes a press release and is furnished under Items 7.01 and 8.01. No financial terms, shareholder actions, or strategic transactions are involved. The event is an ordinary operational update for a biotech company, with no implications for deal activity or corporate control.
